title: NPC Death Corpse Transfer Policy
rules: NPC corpse creation requires authoritative NPC and room identities.
Eligible top-level NPC-owned items transfer to the corpse while preserving runtime identities and nested portable-container relationships.
Explicit npc_no_drop or no_loot instance metadata retains an item with the NPC; unknown native drop flags are not inferred.
Transferred corpse items clear NPC ownership recursively.
NPC Runtime owns death sequencing, loot-table selection, corpse timers, and messages.

bidirectional_relationships.npc_to_corpse_items: NPC identity -> owned item roots -> corpse-held runtime instances
bidirectional_relationships.item_to_npc_death: runtime item instance -> NPC owner -> explicit retention or corpse transfer provenance
